notes: HSBC Life's own site is insurance.hsbc.com.sg. www.hsbc.com.sg/insurance/ is the HSBC bank storefront and links into it.
Site-wide banner: HSBC has agreed to sell HSBC Life Singapore to Allianz, completion expected in the first half of 2027, subject to regulatory approval; existing policies continue unchanged.

Products were taken from the category hub cards on the insurer site. Term Protect Advantage and ValueLife are not on the HSBC Life hubs but are listed on the HSBC bank insurance page and have live pages; channel set to bank.
Pages exist for HSBC Life HappyFamily, CritiCare for Him and CritiCare for Her but none appears on any HSBC Life product hub; left out because sale status is unconfirmed.
HSBC Life Private Wealth VUL is named on the legacy hub as a brochure only (image-only PDF, no product page); left out.
HSBC bank site also sells CancerCare Plus plus travel, home, car, maid and study cover. Those are MSIG products on MSIG documents, not HSBC Life, so are excluded.

Health plans other than Shield are not Integrated Shield Plans; category hospitalisation was used for them with the subtype stating this. International Exclusive and GlobalCare are international private medical plans.
Goal Focus page carried a 37% welcome bonus offer valid to 30 September 2026 (expired); not recorded as a fact.
Riders inside Term Protect Secure and Life Treasure III (CI, TPD, premium waiver) are described on the base product pages and have no pages of their own.
Channel is 'unknown' where the page offers only a callback or Apply now form; bank where the page says to call or visit a branch to apply.
